description: This source file defines configurations, interfaces, extension methods, and classes related to recoverable streams in Orleans. It includes configurator extensions for setting statistics and cache eviction options, as well as a class implementing the recoverable stream configurator for silos.

classes.name: SiloRecoverableStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configures reliable recoverable streams for silos, inheriting from SiloPersistentStreamConfigurator.

methods.name: ConfigureStatistics
methods.description: Extension method to configure statistics options for recoverable streams.

methods.name: ConfigureCacheEviction
methods.description: Extension method to configure cache eviction options for recoverable streams.
